enemies.name: Grunt
enemies.blurb: Fires aimed 3-shot spreads.

enemies.name: Sniper
enemies.blurb: Fast, accurate shots from far away.

enemies.name: Spinner
enemies.blurb: Wanders and sprays spirals in bursts; it spins up while bursting.

enemies.name: The Warden
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 5): a prison riot in three stages — searchlight, gates and gas, then rioters.

enemies.name: Shard
enemies.blurb: Tiny and fast. Comes from the Hive Queen and Splitting elites.

enemies.name: Mortar
enemies.blurb: Lobs bombs at where you stand; they burst into a ring on landing.

enemies.name: Shielder
enemies.blurb: A front shield blocks shots and swings. It turns slowly: flank it.

enemies.name: Hive Queen
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 10): a hive in three stages — drones and bombers, sealing cells and honey, then a frenzied swarm.

enemies.name: Reaper of Dusk
enemies.blurb: Boss pair (wave 15): a tether sweep, then they fuse into the Dual Reaper (pillars, holes), then split for a finale.

enemies.name: The Singularity
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 20): corner gravity wells, pull, lasers and shrinking cages.

enemies.name: The Colossus
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 25): huge stomp rings with one gap, and thrown rocks.

enemies.name: The Duelist
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 30): teleports and leaves decoys that burst unless killed.

enemies.name: The Lich
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 35): immune while its phylactery stands; raises skeletons.

enemies.name: Storm Herald
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 40), three stages: a gathering storm (strikes, lightning rods), a gale that pushes you and bends bullets, then a supercell that marks one player at a time.

enemies.name: The Devourer
enemies.blurb: Boss (wave 45), three stages: hungry for morsels (your shots heal it), then swallowing players, then a mouth that heals it from the front.

enemies.name: The Eclipse
enemies.blurb: Final boss (wave 50), five stages and Totality: a sun and its moon. Hide in the moon's shadow from the flash, stay in the light, and kill it before the nova.

enemies.name: Brute
enemies.blurb: Slow, tough melee bruiser that hits hard (24) when it reaches you.

enemies.name: Lunger
enemies.blurb: Circles in close, flashes a pink line, then leaps along it.

enemies.name: Rioter
enemies.blurb: A prisoner in an orange jumpsuit throwing cuffed punches. Some drag a ball and chain and run slower.

enemies.name: Guard
enemies.blurb: A corrections officer in khaki with a peaked cap and a nightstick. Up close it swings forehand then backhand: step out of the amber arc.

enemies.name: Riot Shield
enemies.blurb: An officer in steel-blue riot gear behind a tall shield that bashes you back. Go round it, or break the shield: then it falls fast.

enemies.name: Gas Grenadier
enemies.blurb: An officer in olive drab and a gas mask, lobbing tear-gas canisters at you. Step out of the cloud.

enemies.name: The Gatekeeper
enemies.blurb: Challenge room mini-boss: a ring of shots with a gap, three aimed fans, and a charge along a shown line that ends in a burst.

enemies.name: Shadow
enemies.blurb: Mirror Match: a dark copy of a player, with their class and their way of fighting. It sidesteps every few seconds.

enemies.name: Shambler
enemies.blurb: Zombie: a wide, slow lurcher that hits hard. Don't get cornered.

enemies.name: Runner
enemies.blurb: Zombie: frail but faster than you walk, in packs of three. Turn and shoot.

enemies.name: Spitter
enemies.blurb: Zombie: hangs back and lobs globs that leave burning, slowing acid. Keep moving.

enemies.name: Crawler
enemies.blurb: Zombie: scuttles low and grabs you, rooting you in place. Shoot it to break free.

enemies.name: Bloater
enemies.blurb: Zombie: swollen and slow; it bursts into a slowing spore cloud. Pop it at range.

enemies.name: Shrieker
enemies.blurb: Zombie: hangs back and screams, sending the horde round it into a frenzy. Silence it.

enemies.name: Mender
enemies.blurb: Zombie: heals the horde round it and makes the dead rise faster. Kill it first.

enemies.name: Swarmer
enemies.blurb: The simplest melee rusher: a white chomper with no eyes that walks straight at you. Weak alone, and it comes in packs.

enemies.name: Taser Guard
enemies.blurb: An officer in slate with a hi-vis band. Keeps its distance, charges its taser and fires a white Fork Bolt that stuns you. Dodge the bolt, or parry it.

enemies.name: Security Guard
enemies.blurb: An officer in navy with a service pistol. Strafes, locks on and fires one tracer round at a time: seven shots, then a long reload. Sidestep the lane, or rush it while it reloads.

enemies.name: Thug
enemies.blurb: A hunched prisoner brute with giant taped fists. Slow and tough, hits hard when it reaches you.

enemies.name: Shiv
enemies.blurb: A prisoner with a taped shank: hooded, or shirtless with one in each hand. Circles in close, flashes a line, then lunges along it.

enemies.name: Spawn Portal
enemies.blurb: A burst of the wave comes through it. Shoot it closed before it empties to cancel the rest; it drops coins for each one it held.

enemies.name: Worker
enemies.blurb: A small, quick worker bee that weaves at you, in loose pairs.

enemies.name: Soldier
enemies.blurb: An armoured bee that rushes straight at you, jaws snapping.

enemies.name: Comb Shield
enemies.blurb: A bee behind a plate of wax cells that stops shots and bashes you back. Break the cells, or go round it.

enemies.name: Honey Lobber
enemies.blurb: Lobs honey at you. A ring marks the spot; the puddle slows whoever stands in it.

enemies.name: Stinger
enemies.blurb: Keeps its distance, charges a venom lance and fires one barbed dart that stuns you. Strafe across the line, or parry it.

enemies.name: Needler
enemies.blurb: Hovers and strafes, locks on, then fires one white needle at a time: seven shots, then a long reload.

enemies.name: Bumble
enemies.blurb: A huge, furry bumblebee. Slow and tough, hits hard when it reaches you.

enemies.name: Hornet
enemies.blurb: Circles in close, flashes a red lane, then darts along it.

enemies.name: Wisp
enemies.blurb: A soul flame that drifts straight at you in a loose pack and burns on touch. Thin them before they reach you.

enemies.name: Acolyte
enemies.blurb: A hooded chaser. Stops just short, raises its sickle over a pale cone, then one wide swing. Step back out of the cone.

enemies.name: Bound Wraith
enemies.blurb: Comes as a pair circling near you, joined by a tether that hurts. Kill one and the other brings it back in 3 s, unless you kill both.

enemies.name: Scythe Wraith
enemies.blurb: Marks a long line through you, then dashes along it and reaps both sides of its path. Leave the line sideways.

enemies.name: Lamplighter
enemies.blurb: Plants its feet, its lantern flares and gold lines show the volley: three lines at you, then a four-way cross.

enemies.name: Mourner
enemies.blurb: Stands still and weeps a twin spiral, one arm each way, then rests. Push in while it rests.

enemies.name: Gravedigger
enemies.blurb: A cultist brute with a shovel. Slow and tough, hits hard when it reaches you.

enemies.name: Shade
enemies.blurb: A shrouded wraith: fades to smoke, shows a ring where it will land, appears and fires.

enemies.name: Debris
enemies.blurb: Tumbling rubble that falls at you on a curving inward spiral, so it's hard to line up.

enemies.name: Void Acolyte
enemies.blurb: A void cultist. Fires three slow orbs: the outer two bend in and meet where you stand. Step forward or back, not sideways.

enemies.name: Pulsar
enemies.blurb: A spinning neutron star. Its two beams flicker for a second, then switch on and sweep a quarter turn. Walk with the sweep.

enemies.name: Graviton
enemies.blurb: Lobs a small gravity well by you every 6 s. For 4 s it drags you in and swallows shots near it. Get clear, or shoot the well.

enemies.name: Orbiter
enemies.blurb: Circles you with three orbs turning round it. One flares, then it slings that orb straight at you, fast.

enemies.name: Collapsar
enemies.blurb: A slow, dense star that shrinks as it's shot. Killed, it collapses: a short pull, then a ring of 12 shots. Kill it at range.

enemies.name: Lens
enemies.blurb: Carries a gravity lens in front of it. Shots into its face curve round it and away; it turns slowly, so hit it from the side.

enemies.name: White Dwarf
enemies.blurb: A small hot star that darts in, flashes white, then shoves you back and turns your shots near it round at you. Stop shooting when it flashes.

enemies.name: Rubble
enemies.blurb: A fist-sized chunk of the Colossus that rolls at you, weaving, in pairs.

enemies.name: Quarryman
enemies.blurb: A quarry worker with a hard hat, a headlamp and a pickaxe. Walks straight at you.

enemies.name: Stomper
enemies.blurb: A slab-shouldered stone brute. Every few seconds it lifts a foot and stomps out a small ring of push blocks with one green gap: step into the gap.

enemies.name: Slab Bearer
enemies.blurb: Carries a quarried slab that stops shots and bashes you back. Break the slab and it drops it as cover for a few seconds; then the bearer falls fast.

enemies.name: Rock Hurler
enemies.blurb: Lobs a boulder where you're heading. Walk out of the ring: it lands hard, bursts into shards and leaves a rubble pile that stops shots.

enemies.name: Driller
enemies.blurb: Circles in close with a jackhammer, shows a lane, then drills along it. The crack it leaves erupts a moment later: get off the line.

enemies.name: Geomancer
enemies.blurb: Keeps its distance, plants its crystal staff and sends a crack racing at you. It glows, then erupts: step off the line.

enemies.name: Cinder Priest
enemies.blurb: Charges a molten core, then fires one magma bolt straight at you. Wherever it stops, it leaves a pool of lava. Strafe across the line, or parry it.

enemies.name: Riot Captain
enemies.blurb: The Warden's mini-boss: a tower shield blocks the front. Bait its shield charge into a wall to daze it; it also fires buckshot, lobs tear gas and whistles for Taser Guards.

enemies.name: Fencer
enemies.blurb: A masked foil-fencer that runs in crowds. Close up it shows a short red line, then hops down it: step off the line.

enemies.name: Blade Dancer
enemies.blurb: Shows a long warning line, then lunges down it and leaves blades hanging on the path. Each fires one shot out of each side: never stand beside the line.

enemies.name: Parrier
enemies.blurb: On guard behind a main-gauche: shots into its front are parried straight back at you, and it bashes you away. It turns slowly: get behind it.

enemies.name: Second
enemies.blurb: Hangs back, glints gold, then throws an aimed fan of five daggers. Slip between them.

enemies.name: Marshal
enemies.blurb: The duel's referee: raises its baton and draws a gold circle round you. For 4 s you can't leave it, and leaning on the edge hurts: fight in the middle.

enemies.name: Gallant
enemies.blurb: Salutes with its sword raised, then lunges at you. Parry it perfectly as it arrives and it reels, open to 50% more damage; dodge it and it rakes the spot.

enemies.name: Harlequin
enemies.blurb: A heavy two-sworded jester. It marks a line through you and dashes it, vaults to the other arm and dashes across: an X of blades that fire out sideways. Stand in a gap of the X.

enemies.name: Mummer
enemies.blurb: A masked player that blinks and becomes three. They circle you and all fire, but only the real one's shots are solid; the copies' are hollow rings. Find the real one.

enemies.name: Mummer
enemies.blurb: One of a Mummer's two copies: its shots are hollow rings that pass through you. It vanishes when its time is up.

enemies.name: Grave Caller
enemies.blurb: Zombie: hangs back and cracks three graves open round you; a Shambler claws out of each. Step out of the ring, then kill it: its risen crumble.

enemies.name: Gnawling
enemies.blurb: A mouth on legs, the Devourer in miniature. Weaves at you in pairs.

enemies.name: Butcher
enemies.blurb: A hooded butcher with a bone mask. Close in, it raises its cleaver and chops a half-circle in front: step out of it.

enemies.name: Gulper
enemies.blurb: A swollen gut. Its cheeks swell, then it breathes in and pulls you toward its mouth: step out of the cone sideways.

enemies.name: Carcass Bearer
enemies.blurb: Carries a side of meat that stops shots and bashes you back. Break it and it drops as a morsel: shoot it or walk over it before a Gnawling eats it.

enemies.name: Bile Spitter
enemies.blurb: Lobs a glob of bile where you're heading. Walk out of the ring: it leaves a pool of acid for a few seconds.

enemies.name: Ember
enemies.blurb: A scrap of solar flare that weaves in at you, dropping sparks that hang in the air behind it.

enemies.name: Corona Priest
enemies.blurb: A sun-cultist. Its halo flares, then bursts into a ring of slow shots: one at you, and a gap beside it.

enemies.name: Heliograph
enemies.blurb: Tilts a sun mirror at you: a line flickers for a second, then becomes a lane of fire. Step off the line.

enemies.name: Moonward
enemies.blurb: A pale knight with a small moon circling it. The moon swallows any shot it touches: fire when it swings round the back.

enemies.name: Gnomon
enemies.blurb: A walking sundial with a sun lantern at its back. The lantern swells, then flashes: the only safe place is the slab's shadow, just to the side of you.

enemies.name: Dusk Lobber
enemies.blurb: Lobs a ball of night that bursts into a pool of the Umbra's dark: you can barely see inside, and it drains you. Stay in the light.

enemies.name: Sickle
enemies.blurb: Throws a crescent blade that loops out through you and comes back round to it. Dodge it twice.

enemies.name: Nova
enemies.blurb: A small unstable star. Close in it lights a 3 s fuse, then goes nova. While lit it takes 50% more damage: burst it or back off.

enemies.name: Gutworm
enemies.blurb: Dives, and a ripple chases you underground. It stops, marks the ground, then erupts with a bite and a ring of shots: get out of the mark.

enemies.name: Hook Thrower
enemies.blurb: Shows a line, then throws a meat hook down it. A hit hurts and reels you in: sidestep the line, or shoot the chain.

enemies.name: Maw Priest
enemies.blurb: Wears the Devourer's jaw: shots into its maw heal it, shots in its back do more. It turns slowly: circle it.

enemies.name: Dust Devil
enemies.blurb: A small whirlwind that weaves in at you. Its touch shoves you hard, into whatever is behind you.

enemies.name: Squall Gunner
enemies.blurb: Carries its own gust: it aims three shots upwind of you, and they curve back onto you. Dodge against the curve.

enemies.name: Stormcaller
enemies.blurb: Raises its staff and calls lightning on you: a ring fills under you, then the strike. Step out of the ring.

enemies.name: Grounder
enemies.blurb: A copper shield grounds your shots. Twelve charge it, and it claps a ring back with two gaps. Flank it.

enemies.name: Pylon
enemies.blurb: Comes in pairs that plant either side of you. The arc between them flickers, then fires. Step off the line, or kill one.

enemies.name: Lineman
enemies.blurb: Hooks a player with a charge. When it runs out it jumps to every ally nearby. The marked player walks away from the team.

enemies.name: Thunderhead
enemies.blurb: A slow, heavy storm cloud. As it rolls at you it drops a row of strikes ahead of it. Sidestep the row.

enemies.name: Turnkey
enemies.blurb: A prison janitor with a ring of keys. Runs from you, stops to plant mines, shackle traps and wet floors, and builds Cell Doors that let Rioters out. Corner it while it works.

enemies.name: Cell Door
enemies.blurb: A Turnkey's cell door: lets a Rioter out every few seconds. It jams shut when its Turnkey dies.

enemies.name: Floor Mine
enemies.blurb: A Turnkey's mine: arms, then beeps and blows when you step close. Shoot it to blow it on enemies.

enemies.name: Shackle Trap
enemies.blurb: A Turnkey's shackle: arms, then snaps shut on the first player over it and holds them a moment. Shoot it to break it.
